questionEnglish: What is the structural and functional unit of the human nervous system?
questionOdia: ମାନବ ସ୍ନାୟୁ ତନ୍ତ୍ରର ଗଠନମୂଳକ ଓ କ୍ରିୟାତ୍ମକ ଏକକ କଣ?
explanation: Neurons (ସ୍ନାୟୁକୋଷ) are specialized cells that transmit electrical nerve impulses throughout the body to control actions and reactions.

questionEnglish: Which part of a neuron receives incoming electrical impulses or chemical signals from other cells?
questionOdia: ସ୍ନାୟୁକୋଷର କେଉଁ ଅଂଶ ଅନ୍ୟ କୋଷରୁ ଆସୁଥିବା ବୈଦ୍ୟୁତିକ ବା ରାସାୟନିକ ସଙ୍କେତ ଗ୍ରହଣ କରେ?
explanation: Dendrites (ଡେଣ୍ଡ୍ରାଇଟ୍) are branch-like structures extending from the cell body that act as receptors for chemical messages.

questionEnglish: What is the microscopic gap across which nerve impulses pass from one neuron to the next called?
questionOdia: ଦୁଇଟି ସ୍ନାୟୁକୋଷ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଥିବା ଅତି କ୍ଷୁଦ୍ର ଶୂନ୍ୟସ୍ଥାନ ବା ସନ୍ଧିକୁ କଣ କୁହାଯାଏ?
explanation: A synapse (ସ୍ନାୟୁସନ୍ଧି) is a specialized junction where chemical neurotransmitters bridge the gap to carry signals between neurons.

questionEnglish: Which part of the human brain is responsible for thinking, memory, intelligence, and voluntary actions?
questionOdia: ମାନବ ମସ୍ତିଷ୍କର କେଉଁ ଅଂଶ ଚିନ୍ତାଶକ୍ତି, ସ୍ମୃତିଶକ୍ତି, ବୁଦ୍ଧିମତା ଏବଂ ଇଚ୍ଛାଧୀନ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ ପାଇଁ ଦାୟୀ?
explanation: The Cerebrum (ପ୍ରମସ୍ତିଷ୍କ) is the largest part of the brain and coordinates logic, learning, speech, emotions, and sensory perceptions.

questionEnglish: Which part of the brain controls involuntary actions like blood pressure, salivation, and vomiting?
questionOdia: ରକ୍ତଚାପ, ଲାଳ କ୍ଷରଣ ଏବଂ ବାନ୍ତି ଭଳି ଅନିଚ୍ଛାକୃତ କ୍ରିୟାଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ମସ୍ତିଷ୍କର କେଉଁ ଅଂଶ ନିୟନ୍ତ୍ରଣ କରେ?
explanation: The Medulla oblongata (ସୁଷୁମ୍ନା ଶୀର୍ଷକ) located in the hindbrain forms the control center for major life-sustaining involuntary activities.

questionEnglish: Which plant hormone is primarily responsible for cell elongation and promoting phototropism?
questionOdia: ଉଦ୍ଭିଦ କୋଷର ଦୀର୍ଘକରଣ ଏବଂ ଆଲୋକାନୁବର୍ତ୍ତନ (Phototropism) ପାଇଁ କେଉଁ ଉଦ୍ଭିଦ ହରମୋନ୍ ମୁଖ୍ୟତଃ ଦାୟୀ?
explanation: Auxin (ଅକ୍ସିନ୍) accumulates on the shaded side of a growing stem, causing those cells to grow longer and bend the plant toward light.

questionEnglish: Which plant hormone acts as a growth inhibitor and induces the wilting of leaves?
questionOdia: କେଉଁ ଉଦ୍ଭିଦ ହରମୋନ୍ ବୃଦ୍ଧି ପ୍ରତିରୋଧକ ଭାବେ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରେ ଏବଂ ପତ୍ର ଝଡ଼ିବାରେ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରେ?
explanation: Abscisic acid (ଆବ୍ସିସିକ୍ ଅମ୍ଳ) signals stress responses in plants, suppressing growth, promoting dormancy, and causing leaf fall.

questionEnglish: Which endocrine gland is known as the 'Master Gland' because it regulates other endocrine glands?
questionOdia: ଅନ୍ୟ ସମସ୍ତ ଅନ୍ତଃସ୍ରାବୀ ଗ୍ରନ୍ଥିକୁ ନିୟନ୍ତ୍ରଣ କରୁଥିବାରୁ କେଉଁ ଗ୍ରନ୍ଥିକୁ 'ମୁଖ୍ୟ ଗ୍ରନ୍ଥି' (Master Gland) କୁହାଯାଏ?
explanation: The Pituitary gland (ପିଟୁଇଟାରୀ ଗ୍ରନ୍ଥି) secretes a range of trophic hormones that dictate the release patterns of downstream glands.

questionEnglish: Which hormone is secreted by the pancreas to regulate blood glucose levels?
questionOdia: ରକ୍ତରେ ଶର୍କରା ବା ଗ୍ଲୁକୋଜ୍‌ର ପରିମାଣ ନିୟନ୍ତ୍ରଣ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ଅଗ୍ନ୍ୟାଶୟ (Pancreas) ରୁ କେଉଁ ହରମୋନ୍ କ୍ଷରିତ ହୁଏ?
explanation: Insulin (ଇନସୁଲିନ୍) is released by the beta cells of the pancreas to facilitate cell uptake of sugar, lowering blood glucose safely.

questionEnglish: Which hormone prepares the human body for 'fight or flight' emergency situations?
questionOdia: ଜରୁରୀକାଳୀନ ପରିସ୍ଥିତିର ମୁକାବିଲା କରିବା ପାଇଁ ମାନବ ଶରୀରକୁ କେଉଁ ହରମୋନ୍ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ କରାଏ?
explanation: Adrenaline (ଆଡ୍ରେନାଲିନ୍) is secreted by the adrenal glands to spike heart rate, respiration, and alertness in times of extreme stress or danger.
